explicit_summary_lines: Kit 1.1.1 adopted through the Kit's own `kit update` (manifest 5a8184255246, signature e7f303d99c564d31cf4bb3dd). For FILE_TRANSFER this is stricter: an order that runs BOUNDED Kit commands or commands outside the Kit manifest needs the local `--allow-unlisted` flag, raw git/gh mutations are always refused, and `expected_current_head` must be the full 40-character commit the order was written on, otherwise `transfer remote-next` stops as STALE_ORDER. Orders that start with the required COMMAND_MANIFEST_ACK line now complete instead of crashing. Evidence: docs/validation/evidence/kit-1.1.1-adoption.json.

Release changelog sections list each change once: `release.changelog_summary: curated` (AGP_CHANGELOG_CURATED_V1) writes the Unreleased entries instead of also every PR title, and release preparation blocks while an Unreleased entry would stay behind.
The build metadata `src/agp_cockpit.egg-info/` is no longer tracked (AGP_NO_TRACKED_EGG_INFO_V1): every `pip install -e .` rewrote it and blocked the Kit's clean-worktree merge preflight.
